locationComparison.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness skeletons)
notes: Northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon: seven level 45 skeletons. This section permits player-versus-player combat; the southern skeleton rooms are outside the Wilderness.

locationComparison.name: Non-Wilderness skeletons
notes: Edgeville Dungeon and the Varrock Sewers hold skeletons for the starter masters.
Both areas are cannonable per the wiki; Edgeville Dungeon is single-way and safespottable, while the Varrock Sewers are multicombat.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 271 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Skeletons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100) plus Turael/Spria (15-30) and Mazchna (30-50) starter masters all assign skeletons.
Skeletons are undead, so the Salve amulet applies; they are weakest to crush melee (crush -5) and have a 35% earth spell weakness.
Krystilia's task counts only Wilderness skeleton kills (e.g. the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon).
Vet'ion and Calvar'ion are boss alternatives; their summoned skeleton hellhounds also progress a Skeleton task. Use each boss's own encounter preparation.
recommendedMethod: Skeletons are undead, so wear a Salve amulet (or Salve amulet (ei)) and hit their crush weakness with a crush weapon; any melee clears them quickly given their low defence, and earth spells exploit the 35% earth weakness for Magic training. For Krystilia, kill Wilderness skeletons at the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; starter masters can be finished safely in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers.
